law: touch the object, understand the object, then offer the operations that pertain to it
aperture: 2-5 actions computed from identity, the capability registry, runtime reachability, the session's closure, its authority, and cost; strength drives visual weight
forbidden_inference: an offered action -> permission already granted; the act still checks scope at the boundary
an absent action -> a missing feature; it is a closure for this viewer
visual weight -> importance in general; it is importance to this viewer now
